reviews.title: Reliable and Quiet – Great First Impression
reviews.comment:
This was my first time using this brand, and after about 8 months of regular use, I’ve had zero issues.
It’s been stable, quiet, and does exactly what you want from a power supply. No weird noise, no power problems—just consistent performance day in and day out.
The fully modular design makes cable management much easier, which is a big plus when building or upgrading a system. Everything feels well-made and thought out.
Overall, great first impression of the brand. Reliable, efficient, and something I’d definitely consider buying again.
reviews.author: Hamza Ramić

reviews.title: Innovative Design Meets High Performance
reviews.comment: The Lian Li Edge Series 1200W PSU is a game-changer for custom PC builds. Its unique L-shaped design simplifies cable management, especially in dual-chamber cases, by reorienting connectors for easier access. The detachable USB and PWM fan hub is a thoughtful addition, allowing for flexible placement and reducing cable clutter. Performance-wise, it delivers consistent power with high efficiency, meeting ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 standards. The build quality is top-notch, featuring a 120mm FDB fan for quiet operation and a removable magnetic dust filter for easy maintenance. Overall, this PSU combines innovation with reliability, making it an excellent choice for modern high-performance systems.
reviews.author: Luxvibe PC

reviews.title: Great PSU! Will be buying another one for the next build.
reviews.comment: The build quality of this PSU is so nice! The cables are almost as good as aftermarket. The1200w size is more than enough power unless you're running some crazy specs. $200 bucks ain't bad either, for sure worth every penny.
reviews.author: Johns

reviews.title: Well made and well presented product
reviews.comment: I was only able to test whether it powers on because the motherboard has yet to arrive; I haven't been able to test the detachable hub. It seems like a good product, well-made and designed, with a very complete set of connection cables, although I thought they would be of higher quality. The packaging is nice, and the magnetic and detachable fan grille is well-made. I hope it serves me well for many years, which is what a PSU should.
